title: Palm
body:
Description

The Palm tree can be found all over the beaches of Finlay and Ferwater. It is identified by the long fronds, curved trunk and that it grows on sand.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for $1 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $23 per stud. You can also use a planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $28 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Palm to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • With it being softer and more expensive than oak, it is a good early game money maker.
